full_judgment:
AKM Fazlur Rahman J: This is a reference under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure submitted by the learned Judge of the Druta Bichar Tribunal No. 1, Dhaka for confirmation of sentence of death awarded by him to condemned prisoner Shahidur Rahman alias Shahid and absconding accused Kala Jahangir convicting them under sections 302/ 120B of the Penal Code in Druta Bichar Tribunal Case No. 8 of 2002 by the judgment and order dated 29-5-2003. 

 6. The prosecution case, in short, is that deceased Advocate Md Habibur Rahman Mondal alias Habib Mondal was the General Secretary of Sutrapur Thana BNP and the Joint Secretary of the Dhaka District Bar Nationalist Ainjibi Forum. He has bitter enmity and rivalry over local politics with accused Shahidur Rahman alias Shahid, Commissioner of Ward No. 83 of Dhaka City Corporation. The deceased used to reside in a rented flat at 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Street of Bonogram Road of Dhaka City. On 20-8-2000 at about 9.30 AM the deceased on way to Dhaka District Court from his residence by a Vespa motorcycle driven by Arshad alias Asad , the Advocate's clerk attached to him, when reached between Barsha Beauty Parlour and Sujan Hair Dresser, at a little distance of his residence, someone called him as Habib Bhai from the back. At this at the indication of the deceased Arshad made the speed of the motorcycle slow. At that time one of the accused persons shot the deceased. The bullet penetrated into the back of his head and exited through his mouth. Then the same bullet hit on the back of Arshad. The deceased and Arshad fell down with the motorcycle. The accused persons came forward to them. Accused Kachi trampled the chest of the deceased. Accused Kala Jahangir, shot with pistol touching above his left ear causing a perforated bullet injury. Other accused persons making blank shots departed, of whom Arshad recognised Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Chakma Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab, Wali Mohammad, Dakat Shahid and Kala Sharif. The deceased was shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital the doctor then declared him dead. Accused Shahidur Rahman @ Shahid made conspiracy of killing the deceased with the other accused persons, in consequence of which the deceased was shot dead. 

 7. On the basis of GD Entry No.1704 dated 20-8-2000 of Ramna Police Station police made inquest of the dead body of the deceased at Dhaka Medical College Hospital and sent the same to the morgue for post mortem examination. After post mortem examination Namaz-e-janaja of the deceased was held in different places and then he was buried. On the same day at 11-25 PM Abdul Hye Bhuiyan, a political associate of the deceased, lodged first information report with Sutrapur Police Station. The Police after investigation of the case submitted final report, against which the informant filed a naraji petition. The learned Magistrate allowed the naraji petition and directed further investigation of the case by CID Accordingly, CID holding further investigation submitted charge sheet against eighteen accused persons. The case was transferred to the Druta Bichar Tribunal No.1, Dhaka, wherein charge under sections 120B/302/307/324/34 of the Penal Code was framed against all the eighteen accused persons, of whom (1) Kachi, (2) Biplab, (3) Shahin, (4) Pichchi Hannan, (5) Tanai Molla, (6) Sentu, (7) Dakat Shahid @ Shahid, (8) Wali Mohammad, (9) Nurul Haq, (10) Kala Jahangir, (11) Opu @ Chakma Opu and (12) Kala Sharif were absconding. The charge was read over to the accused persons on dock, namely, (1) Din Islam @ Dina, (2) Rahman, (3) Shahidur Rahman @ Shahid, (4) Abdul Malek, (5) Alam @ Alamgir and (6) Akhtar Hossain, who pleaded innocence and demanded justice. 

 10. PW 1 Abdul Hye Bhuiyan is the informant. He deposed that he was a resident of Joginagar, while the deceased Habibur Rahman Mandal @ Habib Mandal was a resident of Bonogram Road. He (PW 1) was the Joint Secretary of BNP, Ward No.74 and political associate of the deceased. On 20-8-2000, Sunday, at about 9-30 AM at Bonogram near Barsha Beauty Parlour the deceased was murdered. When he (PW 1) was getting himself ready for going to the Court to appear in a case he got information that the deceased was murdered. He going near Barsha Beauty Parlour found blood and heard that the deceased had already been shifted to the hospital. He informed the incident to Kazi Abul Bashar, Commissioner of Ward No.74. Then he went to Dhaka Medical College Hospital and found the dead body of the deceased. Many people were present there. He further stated that after post mortem examination they taking the dead body of the deceased came to High Court compound. After Namaz-e-janaja of the deceased there the dead body was taken to Dholaikhal, where again Namaz-e-janaja was held. Then the dead body was taken to Dhaka District Bar. After Namaz-e-janaja there the dead body was taken to Mill Barrack at Faridabad within Ward No.82. At the time of occurrence the deceased used to live in a rented house at 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Street of Bonogram Road. The deceased was the General Secretary of BNP, Sutrapur Police Station and the General Secretary of Dhaka District Bar Jatiatabadi Ainjibi Forum. The deceased had conflict and rivalry with accused Shahidur Rahman @ Shahid Commis-sioner. He further stated that on the date of occurrence at 9-00 PM he (PW 1) went to their party central office, where is presence of Sadek Hossain Khoka and Kazi Abdul Bashar the ejahar was written. Therefrom he went to the police station and lodged First Information Report. He proved the First Information Report, Exhibit-1 and his signature therein, Exhibit-1/1. The police submitted final report. He filed a naraji petition. Then further investigation was held by the CID. In the year 2002 he met with Asad, the Muhari (Advocate's clerk) of the deceased, who told him that coming from the residence of the deceased he and the deceased on way to the Court by Vespa motor-cycle driven by him after going 100 yards to the west of the intersection of four roads someone called the deceased as Habib Bhai, from the back, that the deceased placing his hand on his shoulder gave an indication to stop the motor-cycle, that at that time a bullet hit and penetrated into the head of the deceased and exited through his mouth and then hit on his (Asad) back, that the deceased fell down, that a man trampled the chest of the deceased and declared that in sequel of the conflict with Shahid Commissioner the deceased was shot down. Asad also told him that at that time Kala Jahangir shot at the head of the deceased, that accused Kala Jahangir, Kachi, Pichchi Hannan, Chakma Opu, Din Islam, Nurul Haq, Shahin, Akhter, Rahman and others threatened to kill him (Asad) like the deceased if he would give evidence as to the occurrence. This witness further stated that the deceased was the President of BNP Ward No. 82 and also the Chairman of the Development Committee of that ward. In that ward the deceased contested in the election for the post of the Commissioner. At the instance of accused Shahid Commissioner, accused Kala Sharif contested with him and for that the deceased was defeated at a marginal vote. At this the deceased declared that in future he would contest in the election in Ward No.83 with accused Shahid Commissioner. The bitterness between them increased over the murder cases of Michel and Sentu, of which Shahid Commissioner was an accused. Shahid Commissioner understood that it would not be possible for him to remain in politics in presence of the deceased and for that the deceased should be finished. Shahid Commissioner gave money to accused Wali Mohammad for killing the deceased and entrusted Tanai Molla with that work. Thereafter Shahid Commissioner went abroad and the deceased was killed. In cross-examination, this witness stated that deceased Habib Mondal was very much popular in Ward No.74 as a resident of that area by birth. In cross-examination, this witness further stated that he going to the medical college hospital heard from Arshad (PW 8), Milan (PW 7) and Nurul Haq (PW 25) that the dead body of the deceased was lying in the morgue. He could not meet Arshad within 1½ year after the occurrence. He further stated that on the date of occurrence in the medical college hospital he heard the occurrence from Arshad, Nurul Haq and Milan. This witness further stated that on that day none told him who killed the deceased. He further said that on the date of occurrence he went to the hospital at 10-30 and stayed there till 01-00/01-30 PM. He did not state the occurrence of killing the deceased to the leaders of BNP who visited the hospital, as at that time he did not know the occurrence. He did not know whether Arshad appeared before the police in the hospital. He was not present at the time of making inquest of the dead body. None of the vicinity of the place of occurrence disclosed that he had witnessed the occurrence. After his arrival in the BNP Central Office the leaders asked him to be informant of the case. At the time of filing naraji petition on 19-6-2001 Awami League was in power. Before filing naraji petition he did not meet Arshad. He searched for Arshad, but he did not dare to go to Arshad's residence in Ward No.82. He made no GD Entry as to missing of Arshad. He denied the suggestion that subsequently prevailing upon Arshad the accused persons were falsely implicated. He further stated that when BNP came to power he was out of town. He admitted that he did not state in the FIR that the deceased had conflict with accused Shahid Commissioner. He denied the suggestion that Shahid Commissioner had been falsely implicated due to political rivalry. The deceased was the owner of the house of Holding No. 96 of Bonogram. He frankly conceded that he had no direct knowledge about the occurrence. He denied the defence suggestion that in the sequel to conflict amongst local BNP leaders the deceased was assassinated. 

 11. PW 2 Kamal Hossain deposed that in the year 1995 he had a video games shop at 52 Dhalkhanagar Lane. The ruffians of the locality used to demand toll/donation in his shop and also used to disturb him. He reported the matter to the neighbouring shopkeepers. They advised him to complain to Shahid Commissioner. Thereafter through Shahid Commissioner he was acquainted with his (Shahid Commissioner's) men, namely Nuruddin, Lokman and Yahia, with whom later on his friendship developed. He used to visit the house of Shahid Commissioner with them and Shahid Commissioner would send him with them to collect his income in the business of phensidyl and heroin. He would go to the new house of Shahid Commissioner and use to do his various works. There was 'berar ghar' (bamboo fence-made hut) in the field beside Shahid Commissioner's house, where Shahid Commissioner would sit with his men for conspiracy. One day in the month of June 2000, (the date could not be remembered), in the afternoon, he (PW 2) was chatting with Nuruddin, Lokman and Yahia standing in the field near that bamboo-fence hut. At the same time Shahid Commissioner was talking with his men in that hut. Someone from that but called any one of them (he, Yahia, Nuruddin and Lokman). In response to such call he (PW 2) went to the but and found Shahid Commissioner, Tanai Molla, Nurul Haq, Kala Jahangir, Malek, Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Dila, Wali Mohammad, Shahin, Kala Sharif and 3/4 others. They asked him to serve them tea. At this he fetching tea served them. At that time Shahid Commissioner was saying to those accused persons that Habib Mondal was an obstacle on his way, that the popularity of Habib Mondal was increasing day by day, that he (Shahid Commissioner) heard that Habib Mondal would contest with him in the next ward commissioner election, that he (Shahid Commissioner) was made accused in different cases by Habib Mondal, that he managed to cut his name from those cases but Habib Mondal filed naraji petitions, that it would not be possible for him to live in peace if Habib Mondal would remain alive, that they had to do something, that in the next month he (Shahid Commissioner) would go to London, that the money would be required had been kept with Wali Mohammad. He (Shahid Commissioner) instructed other accused persons to follow the direction of Tanai Molla. He further instructed them to kill the deceased during his staying in London. Tanai Molla assured him that from London he would get the news of killing of Habib Mandal. Shahid Commissioner under-took to manage the case if would be filed against any one of them. Other accused persons present there assured Shahid Commissioner to obey his instructions. After such discussion at the time of 'Azan' of Magrib prayer all of them departed. PW 2 further said that his statement was recorded by the Magistrate. His such statement was marked as Exhibit-2. He further said that later on he heard that Habib Mondal was assassinated. This witness identified accused Shahid Commissioner and Abdul Malek on dock. He stated that he did not know the other accused persons on dock. In cross-examination, he stated that he used to live in a rented house at holding No.261 of Mir Hazirbag. There was a beel to the east of the house of Shahid Commissioner. He then said that there was a rail line to the east of that house and a pond to the north. Bamboo made huts and some slums were standing to the north of that pond. There were some houses and a 'mazar' to the south of the house of Shahid Commissioner. The but made of bamboo was situated 100/150 cubits west of the house of Shahid Commissioner. There was no house between the but and the house of Shahid Commissioner. The house of Shahid Commissioner was a six-storied big building. He admitted that he did not state to the investigating officer and also to the Magistrate that his neighbouring shop-keepers had advised him to complain to Shahid Commissioner against the ruffians who used to demand subscription/donation in his shop and that he was acquainted with Nuruddin, Lokman and Yahia through Shahid Commissioner. He did not take the investigating police to Nuruddin, Yahia and Lokman and to the place of conspiracy, that is, the bamboo-made hut. He did not know who took him to the investigating officer. He voluntarily stated that the people who had complicity in the occurrence might have disclosed his name to the police. Accordingly, police went to his house and quizzed him and recorded his statement in the month of February. In the month of May he was produced before the Magistrate by the same police. He did not know the father's name and address of the accused persons whose names he stated. 

 12. PW 3 Zakir Hossain stated that he was a rickshaw puller. On 20-8-2000 at 7-30 AM he went out with his rickshaw and carried passengers in different places. At 9-00 AM he took a passenger from Dholaikhal for going to Thatari Bazar. At 9-30 AM he heard sound of shot at Bonogram Road. He looking at the front saw Habib Mondal being hit by bullet lying on the ground. There was bleeding from his head. He found Arshad, the Assistant of Habib Mondal, standing beside Habib Mondal. He further said that he saw some people with arms to decamp, amongst whom he could recognise 4/5 persons. They were Kala Sharif, Kachi, Shahin, Malek and Dila. Many others were with them, whom he would be able to identify if he could see them again. At the time of retreating they were firing shots. He was standing with his rickshaw beside them. He saw that his passenger being afraid left the place. Arshad and Nurul Haq lifted Habib Mondal on his rickshaw. He carried them upto Gulistan, wherefrom they took away Habib Mondal to the hospital by a scooter. Among the accused persons on dock he identified accused Malek and stated that he could identify the other accused persons if they would have been available on dock. In cross-examination he stated that on that date he did not disclose the occurrence to anybody out of fear. Arshad led the police to his house. None besides Munshi Atiqur Rahman was present when he was quizzed by him in his residence in the evening. He denied the suggestions that he was not a rickshaw puller or that the deceased was not shifted from the place of occurrence by his rickshaw or that as a tutored witness he was deposing falsely. He admitted that before giving statement to the investigating officer he never stated the occurrence to anybody. For long time he did not meet Arshad and Nurul Haq. He and Arshad used to live in the same area. He did not know the fathers' names and addresses of accused Kala Sharif, Din Islam and Shahin. He denied the suggestion that he was not present in the scene and did not witness the occurrence. 

 13. PW 4 Azharul Islam Titu deposed that he was the proprietor of a computer centre at 4/1/D Hare Street, Wari. On 20-8-2000 at 8-30 AM on way to that computer centre from his residence he saw a white microbus standing in front of Silver Deal Preparatory School intervened by 3/4 buildings from his office. At about 8-45/9-00 AM while he was sitting at his office he heard sound of shots. He came out of his office and following the sound of shots proceeded towards Silver Deal Preparatory School and found some people making blank shots. Then those people boarded on the micro-bus. Amongst them he could recognise accused Alamgir, Rahman, Malek and Akhter and later on reading newspaper he could identify accused Kala Jahangir, Pichchi Hannan, Biplab and Sentu. The microbus went towards east. Then proceeding towards west he heard hue and cry. He found Habib Mondal lying beside Barsha Beauty Parlour. Arshad and Nurul Haq lifted Habib Mondal on a rickshaw. He shared with them. Habib Mondal was shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. This witness identified accused Alamgir, Malek, Akhter and Rahman on dock and said that he could identify other accused persons if they would have been available on dock. In cross-examination he stated that he had faith on BNP politics. Deceased Habib Mondal by birth was a resident of Ward No. 74. When he came to know that CID took up further investigation of the case he going to the investigating officer of CID gave statement. Before that for want of security he did not give any statement to the police. When BNP came to power and Shahid Commissioner was arrested he became anxiety free. He was a tenant of holding No. 96, Bonogram Road since 1974 or 1975. This holding belonged to the father of Habib Mondal. He had connection with politics, but he was not active. On the date of occurrence at 5-00 PM he met the wife of deceased Habib Mondal in her residence. Before that he was in his place of work. He did not disclose the occurrence to the people present in the hospital. He told the occurrence to his known persons. He denied the suggestions that as he was a tenant of the house of Habib Mondal being influenced by the members of Habib Mondal's family and due to political biasness he deposed falsely or that due to the local political conflicts Habib Mondal was done to death or that he recognised none of the accused persons. 

 14. PW 5 Kabir Jhantu stated that on 16-6-1999 his younger brother Sentu was gunned down, while he was traveling with him. Accused Shahid Commissioner was the main accused in that case and Habib Mondal was their lawyer. Police submitted charge sheet against two accused persons and final report against the FIR named accused persons. Then at his instance Habib Mondal filed a naraji petition against that police report. Two/ three months after that one morning Habib Mondal was murdered. He believed that Habib Mondal was killed as he filed the naraji petition in his case and that Shahid Commissioner had hand in that killing. In cross-examination, he admitted that he was an accused in Sutrapur PS Case No. 81(7)/2000 under sections 326/302/ 34 of the Penal Code, Sutrapur PS Case No. 34 (7)/1999 under sections 302/34, Sutrapur PS Case No. 34(11)/2001 under sections 326/307/ 34 and Sutrapur PS Case No. 2(4)/2002 under Druta Bichar Ain. He stated that accused Shahid Commissioner while was in custody was elected as the Commissioner of Ward No. 83. Shahid Commissioner never contested in the election for the post of Commissioner of Ward No. 82. 

 15. PW 6 Emamuzzaman Pintu stated that his brother Michel was shot dead by Sharif, Kamal and Mohan at the behest of Shahid Commissioner. In that case police submitted final report against Shahid Commissioner. He filed naraji petition against that final report through deceased Advocate Habib Mondal. This witness further stated that he believed that Shahid Commissioner killed the deceased as he filed naraji petition against him. Shahid Commissioner had involvement in many other killings in their area. In cross-examination, he admitted that he was an accused in some murder cases. He also admitted that Shahid Commissioner was not FIR-named accused in the murder case of his brother, Michel. As the Chairman of the development committee of Ward No. 82 the deceased had acquired popularity. 

 16. PW 7 Manjurul Huq alias Milan stated that he was the President of Chhatra Dal of Ward No. 82 and the Political Secretary of deceased Advocate Habib Mondal, who was the Joint Secretary of Sutrapur BNP and President of BNP of Ward No. 82. On the date of occurrence on 20-8-2000 at about 9-30 AM on way to the residence of deceased Habib Mondal at Bonogram from his house at Alamganj through Hare Street he saw a white microbus standing in front of Silver Deal School. Then he heard sound of gunshots to the west. At this he being frightened stood at the gate of Nibedita Clinic and heard sound of shots to the west at a little distance and saw accused Kala Jahangir, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Kachi, Biplab, Opu, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Din Islam and Alamgir firing shots and coming from the west to the microbus. Amongst them, Kala Jahangir, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Malek, Rahman, Sentu and Kachhi boarded on the microbus and the microbus departed towards east. The remaining accused persons departed by rickshaw. He then ran towards the house of Habib Mondal at Bonogram and found a gathering of people to the west of that house at Bonogram Road. He approached to the gathering and found Habib Mondal lying with blood. Arshad and Nurul Haq were standing beside him. They jointly lifted Habib Mondal on a rickshaw. Arshad and Nurul Haq shifted Habib Mondal to the hospital by that rickshaw. He followed them by another rickshaw. The doctor declared Habib Mondal dead. He further stated that whom he saw to board on the microbus were men of their locality. In the year 1996 the residence of Habib Mondal was attacked and in that incident Helal was done to death. In the year 1998 the house of Habib Mondal was attacked again. Accused Shahid Commissioner and his terrorist cohorts on different occasions attempted to kill Habib Mondal. For that Habib Mondal made a GD entry with Kotwali Police Station. He had talk with Habib Mondal, who told him that none besides Shahid Commissioner would be able to kill him. This witness further said that long after the occurrence Arshad told him that accused Kala Jahangir, Kachi, Pichchi Hannan, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Wali, Shahin, Din Islam, Akhter and Dakat Shahid shot Habib Mondal. This witness identified accused Rahman, Alamgir, Malek and Akhter on the dock. In cross-examination he admitted that he was an accused in Sutrapur PS Case No. 107(4)97, in which charge sheet was submitted against him. His brother Anwarul Haq Anu was an accused of many murder cases of Sutrapur Police Station. In the year 1991 Habib Mondal himself appointed him (PW 7) as his Political Secretary. The paternal house of Habib Mondal was at Bonogram Road. Habib Mondal was a political personality in Ward No. 74. He also said that he used to serve at 45/4 Prasanna Podder Lane under Kotwali Police Station as a Computer Graphic Designer. Prasanna Podder Lane was to the south-west of Bonogram at a distance of half a mile and to the north-west of his house. To go to Prasanna Podder Lane from his residence he had to pass through the Court area and English Road. Kazi Abul Bashar was the Commissioner of Ward No. 74. Informant Abdul Hye was known to him. He was their party man. On the date of occurrence he had no scope to say to the informant what he had seen. Getting information of death of Habib Mondal the Central and City leaders of BNP came to see the dead body. From the date of occurrence till 19-6-2001 he did not tell what he saw to the leaders of his party. He gave statement to the investigating officer Munshi Atiqur Rahman on 19-2-2002. He denied the suggestion that on the date of occurrence he did not go to the place of occurrence and did not see the accused persons whom he named. 

 17. PW 8 Arshad alias Asad stated that he was attached to deceased Advocate Habibur Rahman Mondal since 1993 as an Advocate's Clerk. In the year 1990 Habib Mondal was elected as the President of BNP of Ward No. 82. In the year 1991 he was selected as the Chairman of the Development Committee of that ward. The popularity of Habib Mondal in that ward increased as he had done many development works. At this accused Shahidur Rahman, Commissioner of Ward No. 83, became jealous. In the year 1994 deceased Habib Mondal contested in the election for the post of Commissioner of Ward No. 82. In that election at the instance of accused Shahid Commissioner accused Kala Sharif contested with Habib Mondal, but he was defeated in that election. After the election in a meeting of the supporters and workers of Habib Mondal told that he was defeated due to Shahid Commissioner. Habib Mondal then declared that in the next election he would contest for the post of the Commissioner of Ward No. 83. requested his workers to be ready for that election. At this Shahid Commissioner became furious against him. In the year 1995 Shahid Commissioner made conspiracy to kill Habib Mondal. In this regard Habib Mondal made a GD entry with Sutrapur Police Station, being GDE No. 9646 dated 29-5-1995. A copy of that GD entry, filed by this witness, was marked as Exhibit-3 with objection. In the year 1996 when Awami League came to power, the house of Habib Mondal was attacked. In that incident his neighbour Helal Uddin was murdered. There was explosion of bombs in his residence and he narrowly escaped. A case was filed against Shahid Commissioner and his men Kachi, Alamgir and others. Police took no step to arrest the accused persons of that case as Awami League was in power. At this Habib Mondal shifted his residence to 53/7 Haricharan Roy Road. In the year 1997 accused Wali Mohammad filed a case being Sutrapur Police Station Case No. 107(4)/1997 against Habib Mondal. In the year 1998 Habib Mondal went into custody. At that time Shahid Commissioner falsely implicated some followers of Habib Mondal in a concocted case. In the year 1998 Habib Mondal married in the area of Ward No. 82. At the behest of Shahid Commissioner a worker of Habib Mondal, namely, Sujan alias Michel was killed. The officer-in-charge of the police station refused to record the case against Shahid Commissioner. The case was recorded in the name of others. FIR was lodged in the name of Shahid Commissioner and others in connection with Sentu murder case. One day in the month of April or May, 2000 (the date could not be remembered), at about 11-00 AM, one Babu alias Teypa Babu came to the chamber of Habib Mondal and informed him that Shahid Commissioner offered him Taka 5,00,000 and arms for killing him (Habib Mondal), but he did not agree. Teypa Babu alerted Habib Mondal as he might be killed by the cohort of Shahid Commissioner. Teypa Babu also advised him to shift his residence from Ward No. 82. In the murder cases of Michel and Sentu final reports were submitted against Shahid Commissioner. On behalf of the informant of those cases Habib Mondal as an Advocate filed naraji petitions, which were rejected. Habib Mondal preferred revisions against those orders of rejection of naraji petitions. Then Habib Mondal rented a flat in the 4th floor of 10/2 Chandra Mohan Basak Street. On the date of occurrence on 20-8-2000 at about 8-30 AM he (PW 8) came to the house of Habib Mondal on a Vespa motorcycle. Habib Mondal came down from his residence at about 09-15/09-30 AM for going to the Court. He (PW 8) sat on the seat of the driver of the vespa and Advocate Habib Mondal took his seat on his back. He started the motor-cycle. After going 25/30 yards west he turned towards the south and after going 10/12 yards ahead, someone from the back called Habib Mondal addressing him Habib Bhai. At this Habib Mondal placing his hand on his shoulder indicating to stop. He made speed of the motor-cycle slow on the road between Barsha Beauty Parlour and Sujan Hair Dresser. At that time a bullet hit on the back of the head of Habib Mondal. He (PW 8) felt pain on his back. The bullet perforating the head of Habib Monal exited through his mouth and hit on his (PW 8) back. He fell down from the motor-cycle and thereafter he stood up. He found accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Chakma Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab, Wali Mohammad, Dakat Shahid, Kala Sharif and 2/3 others coming forward. Accused Kachi trampled the chest of Habib Mondal and Kala Jahangir shot touching a pistol above his left ear. Then many shots were made by the accused persons. The neighbouring people were threatened by fire. Accused Kachi said that in sequel of conflict with Shahid Commissioner Habib Mondal had been taught a good lesson at the behest of Shahid Commissioner. The accused being sure about the death of the deceased told him (PW 8) that he (PW 8) was left alive on consideration that he was a gentle boy of the locality. They threatened him that his condition would be same as of Habib Mondal, if he would disclose the occurrence to anybody and give evidence against them. Thereafter accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi and Biplab marking shots went away towards east and accused Dakat Shahid, Wali Mohammad and Kala Sharif went through Bonogram Road towards south of Tipu Sultan Road. Immediately after the occurrence Manjurul Haq Milan (PW 7), Azharul Islam Titu (PW 4), Nurul Haq (PW 25) and others came to him running. Zakir (PW 3) also came forward with his rickshaw. He and Nurul Haq (PW 25) lifted Habib Mondal on that rickshaw and shifted him upto Gulistan by that rickshaw, wherefrom by scooter they took the deceased to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. The doctor on duty in the emergency department after examining Habib Mondal declared him dead. Thereafter he felt pain on the right side of his back. He (PW 8) stood up and found accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Chakma Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab, Wali Mohammad, Dakat Shahid, Kala Sharif and 2/3 others came to them. Accused Kachi pressed the chest of the deceased by his foot and accused Kala Jahangir touching a pistol above the left ear of the deceased shot. Thereafter other accused persons making blank shots threatened the neighbouring people. Accused Kachi said that the deceased was shot at the order of Shahid Commissioner as he exceeded his limitation. The accused persons showing threat forbid him not to give evidence and disclose to anybody what he saw, otherwise his fate would be like the deceased. Then accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab decamped to the east making shots and accused Dakat Shahid, Wali Mohammad and Kala Sharif departed towards Tipu Sultan Road. In the meantime PWs 4, 7 and 25 came there running PW 3 also came with his rickshaw. He (PW 8) and PW 25 lifted the deceased on the rickshaw of PW 3 and took him upto Gulistan by that rickshaw and then availing a scooter took him to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. The doctor declared the deceased dead. This witness further testified that he did not disclose the occurrence to anybody out of fear of the accused and remained hiding in different places for 1½ year. When BNP came to power, Shahid Commissioner was arrested and CID took up investigation of the case he gained courage. He went to the house of the informant on 18-2-2002 and then gave statement to the investigating officer. Being afraid of the accused persons he kept his lips tightened up. 

 52. PW 3 gave evidence that he was a rickshaw puller. On the date of occurrence on way to Thatari Bazar from Dholaikhal with a passenger on his rickshaw through Bonogram Road about 9-30 AM he heard sound of shots and looking at the front found the deceased being shot lying on the ground with bleeding injuries and PW 8 standing beside him. He also saw some armed persons leaving. Amongst them he recognised Kala Sharif, Kachi, Shahin, Malek and Dila. They were making blank fire. He could not recognise the others. He further testified that PWs 8 and 25 lifted the deceased on his rickshaw. He plied the rickshaw with them upto Gulistan, wherefrom the deceased was taken to the hospital by a scooter. Out of fear of the accused he did not disclose the occurrence to anybody. PW 8 came to his house with the police, when he for the first time gave statement narrating the occurrence. Before that he did not meet PWs 8 and 25. He denied (sic) also accused Kala Jahangir, Kachi, Malek Kala Sharif, Alamgir, Dakat Shahid, Shahin, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Dila, Rahman, Sentu, Wali Mohammad, Biplab and Chakma Opu present there, Kachi pressed the chest of the deceased by foot and told that in sequel of the conflict with Shahid Commissioner the deceased was taught a good lesson at the order of Shahid Commissioner. Then Kala Jahangir touching a pistol on the head of the deceased shot. The accused persons threatened to shoot him (PW 25) if he would come forward. This witness further said that accused Kala Sharif, Dakat Shahid, Shahin and Wali Mohammad walked hurriedly towards Tipu Sultan Road and others departed towards Silver Dale School making shots. PW 25 approached to the deceased. PWs 4 and 7 also came there. He (PW 25) and PW 8 took the deceased to Gulistan by a rickshaw, wherefrom availing a baby-taxi they shifted the deceased to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. The doctor declared him dead. 

 53. PW 8 is a FIR named witness. At the time of occurrence he was going to the Court with the deceased by the same motorcycle and witnessed the occurrence. The FIR is the earliest recorded version of prosecution case. It supports presence of PW 8 with the deceased at the time of occurrence. Moreover, PWs 3, 4, 7 and 25 corroborated his such presence at the scene. Undoubtedly PW 8 witnessed the occurrence. He gave acceptable explanation of delay in disclosing the fact of his witnessing the occurrence and recognising the accused. His explanation that out of fear of the accused person who threatened to kill him like Habib Mondal if he would disclose the occurrence, he hid himself for one and half year in different places and did not disclose the occurrence to anybody. PW 21 testified that he tried his best to find our PW 8, who was accompanying the deceased at the time of occurrence, but could not trace him out. The parents of PW 8 informed him (PW 21) that PW 8 was absconding. PW 1 the informant and PW 15 the wife of the deceased corroborated that after the occurrence PW 8 hid himself. They did not find him out PW 8 testified that when BNP came to power, the investigation of the case was taken up by CID and accused Shahidur Rahman was arrested, he then got courage, came out from hiding place and untighted his lips. He with the informant going to the investigating officer gave statement narrating the occurrence. 

 54. CID took up investigation of the case in the month of September 2001 and BNP came to power in the month of October 2001. Shahidur Rahman was shown arrested in this case, some days after he was arrested in another case. Thus non disclosure of the occurrence by PW 8 has been well explained. PW 8 was not a partisan witness. He had no motive of falsely implicating the accused persons. His evidence is unshaken and does not suffer from any infirmity. There is no contradiction or inconsistency in material particulars in his evidence. His evidence as to the manner of shooting the deceased is consistent with the medical evidence and corroborated by PW 25. His evidence is credible and should not be rejected branding him partisan or tutored only because he was a clerk of the deceased. Rather he is a natural and competent witness. The case of Abu Taher Chowdhury vs State, 42 DLR (AD) 253 referred by the learned lawyer for the defence as to rejecting the evidence of a witness due to delay in disclosing the fact of his witnessing the occurrence has no manner of application in the instant case. The principle of law enunciated in the case of Mahmudul Islam vs State, 53 DLR (AD) 1 that in view of the present law and order situation prevailing in the country nowadays it is not unlikely that a witness will not dare to tell the truth for fear of his life, is applicable here. In that case fear of the accused was accepted as a genuine ground of belated disclosure of the names of the assailants. The consensus of judicial opinion is that if believed conviction can be based on the solitary evidence of a witness, of course, if the veracity of the witness is not tainted in any manner [vide 29 DLR (SC) 2111. The evidence of PW 8 is of unimpeachable character. His such evidence may be the sole basis of conviction of the accused whom he saw and recognised at the time of shooting the deceased to death. As found above the evidence of PW 8 is not tainted in any manner. He recognised (1) Kala Jahangir, (2) Malek, (3) Rahman, (4) Sentu, (5) Chakma Opu, (6) Pichchi Hannan, (7) Akhter, (8) Alamgir, (9) Kachi, (10) Biplab, (11) Wali Mohammad (acquitted), (12) Dakat Shahid and (13) Kala Sharif. He testified that accused Kachi pressed the chest of the deceased by foot and Kala Jahangir shot touching pistol above the left ear of the deceased. All of them being armed with firearms jointly attacked the deceased and departed at a time after shooting the deceased. 

 57. The accused persons being armed with firearms attacked the deceased and two of them shot him, of whom one was unidentified and another is Kala Jahangir. Thereafter all of them at a time decamped making shots. This manner of occurrence proves common intention of all of them in causing death of the deceased. Thus it is well proved that in furtherance of the common intention of all the deceased was gunned down. It cannot be said that the accused persons who had. no active participation or over act, as much as did not fire at the deceased cannot be held liable under section 34 read with section 302 of the Penal Code. In this regard the case of State vs Abul Khair, 44 DLR 284 may be referred, wherein relying on the cases of Barendra Kumar Ghosh vs King Emperor, AIR 1925 PC 1 and Tukuram Gampat Pnadare vs State of Mahaashtra, AIR 1974 SC 514 it is held that in order to attract section 34 it is not necessary that any overt act must be done by the particular accused and that section 34 shall be applicable if it is established that the criminal act has been done by any one of the accused persons in furtherance of the common intention of all. The case of Aminul Islam vs State, 12 MLR 21 =12 BLC 332 referred by Mr Munsurul Haque Chowdhury, the learned Advocate, has no manner of application as the facts and circumstances of that case are quite distinguishable from those of the present case. 

 63. None of Yahia, Nuruddin and Lokman was examined to corroborate PW 2. Moreover, PW 2 did not state to the investigating officer that at the material time he was talking with them in the field near the hut. Moreso, he did not disclose about the conspiracy to anybody. None took him to the investigating officer to say about conspiracy. He did not know who informed the investigating officer that he had knowledge about the conspiracy. He stated that the conspirators might have disclosed his name as the person aware of the conspiracy to the investigating officer. It is highly impracticable. PW 27 said that through secret source knowing that PW 2 was aware of the conspiracy he went to the residence of PW 2 at 261 Mirhazaribag on 21-2-2002 and 25-2-2002. None produced PW 2 to him. He found out him on search. PW 2 did not disclose to anybody that he knew the conspiracy. In that case PW 27 had no occasion to be aware that PW 2 is a witness of the conspiracy. It finds support of the defence contention that PW 2 is a creation of PW 27. 

 64. PW 27 recorded the statements of PW 2 on 21-2-2002 and then on 25-2-2002. The statement recorded on 21-2-2002 was purposely suppressed. It was replaced by a new one recorded on 25-2-2002. It gives indication of something wrong. PW 2 disclosed the story of conspiracy, firstly and lastly, to the investigating officer one and half year after. There is no explanation of such belated disclosure. Such unexplained and inordinate delay in such disclosure casts serious doubt as to the credibility of his evidence. In view of the above facts and circumstances the evidence of PW 2 as to the conspiracy does not inspire confidence. 

 65. PW 26 gave evidence that in the first part of 1995 in the house of one Anwar Hossain at Dhalka Nagar Shahid Commissioner called a meeting, wherein Shahid Commissioner, Wali Mohammad, Tanai Molla, Nurul Haq, he (PW 26), Riaz, Rafi and Arif were present. In that meeting decision was taken that the deceased would be killed. He further stated that in the year 1998, in a wedding ceremony at Dhupkhola Community Centre, Shahid Commissioner took decision of implementing the decision of killing the deceased, taken in the house of Anwar Hossain earlier. Such evidence of PW 26 as to conspiracy is vague and suffers from inherent defect and infirmity. Such conspiracy as said was made firstly in the year 1995 and then in the year 1998. The occurrence took place on 20-8-2000, long after said conspiracy. It is very much difficult to link up the belated murder of the deceased with such conspiracy. No logical inference can be drawn that in consequence of such conspiracy the deceased was shot down. No date and time of alleged conspiracy was given. There is no corroboration of the evidence of PW 26. Moreover PW 26 is not a man of confidence. He was an absconding accused of many murder cases. In the above context it is difficult to reject the contention of the defence that PWs 2 and 26 are the creation of PW 27.
